thread:
raj-recruiter: Heads-up — Maria (START 2026-04-12) — spouse filed H4 EAD renewal ~6 weeks ago, still pending. Maria asked whether we can proceed with benefits enrollment for spouse at start date if SSN hasn't come through yet. cc @sara-peopleops @alan-hiringmgr
sara-peopleops: Short answer: usually yes, we can provisionally enroll dependents w/receipt notice but benefits vendor often needs SSN later. Need to confirm with Fidelity/Gusto. Can you upload the USCIS receipt + I-94?
maria-newhire: Uploaded the receipt notice and I-94 to the candidate folder: https://drive.company/boxed/maria/imm (perm link) — receipt number ends with 1234. Spouse passport and marriage certificate also in same folder.
imm-counsel: From counsel: vendors will accept a USCIS receipt notice for initial enrollment in many cases; SSN should be provided within 30–60 days of enrollment. If EAD is eventually approved, provide EAD card copy ASAP. Keep written note on file.
sara-peopleops: Thanks — I'll open a case with Fidelity now. Two asks for the folder: 1) receipt notice (I-797C) screenshot, 2) copy of marriage certificate. Raj can you confirm both are in the folder?
raj-recruiter: Confirmed — both are in the folder. I also added a short note with the case timeline.
payroll-team-bot: @sara-peopleops FYI — if we enroll dependent without SSN, benefits deductions will still start; however vendor may retroactively require SSN and make adjustments. No payroll tax impact until SSN is provided.
sara-peopleops: Good to know. I will request provisional enrollment and flag "pending SSN" with vendor. If vendor rejects, contingency plan is COBRA enrollment for spouse for first 30 days — we can cover employer portion for one month while they sort SSN. Thoughts?
alan-hiringmgr: That's fine from team side. We don't want Maria delayed. Approve covering employer portion for 30 days if needed.
maria-newhire: Appreciate it — start date unchanged then. Quick Q: if EAD comes through after start and SSN shows up, do I just upload to the same folder?
sara-peopleops: Yes — upload to the same folder and tag me. Also email benefits@redwood with subject "Maria — dependent SSN update" so vendor gets alerted.
imm-counsel: One more legal note: keep copy of receipt + enrollment confirmation in employee file for audit. If there's any change in dependent eligibility, notify security/compliance.
payroll-team-bot: Noted. payroll will not change pre-tax elections until SSN is recorded. If vendor charges retro premiums we will process adjustments in the next payroll cycle.
raj-recruiter: I'll message Maria the plan and request she pings us when she gets any USCIS updates.
sara-peopleops: I'll open vendor case and post update here by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
maria-newhire: Thank you everyone! :pray:
